A '''laboratory''' was located on the fringes of the [[Niorde system/Legends|Niorde system]] in [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was here that the [[Niordi]] created their [[Niordi living weapon|living weapons]] to defend their [[Planet/Legends|home planet]] of [[Niorde]] from the advances of the [[Leech Legion]]s.
